Name: Joah, Son of Zimmah
Summary: Joah, son of Zimmah of the Gershonites, was one of the Levites who arose to cleanse the house of the LORD under Hezekiah, and the father of Eden.
KeyStory: Of the Gershonites, Joah the son of Zimmah and Eden the son of Joah arose to cleanse the house.
RelatedPeople: Eden, Son of Joah; King Hezekiah; Zimmah, Father of Joah; Zimmah, Son of Jahath
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Joah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
